title: 第二百零二章
slug: 缺爱小可怜重回爸妈十八岁那年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

余疏问：“你是不是很在意我。”

两人关系看似是余疏在主动，实际上一直都由祝予把控着。

以前祝予对他也不错，但远不及现在。

过去在祝家短住的时间里，余疏最常做的事儿就是坐在那里，看祝予跟周复之还有祝今也说话。

只要这两人在场的情况下，祝予大半的注意力都会在他们身上，那种专注是当初还不知道真相的他不能理解的。

看久了，余疏心里也生出了贪欲。

他也想要这种目光。

这种永远不会被祝予放弃、割舍，长久凝视的目光。

原本以为他要努力很久，直到前段时间跟祝予重逢。

相处过程中，余疏逐渐发现了他想要的，祝予好像开始慢慢给予。

因此他也试探着，大胆的跨过了那条线。

现在看来，余疏觉得她眼中似乎有了自己的身影。

虽然还做不到跟祝今也跟周复之比拟，但总归被她看到了。

眼神是有魔力的，纵使祝予不知道余疏在想什么，但也从中感受到了他的一些情绪。

这回祝予没有像刚才那样敷衍，而是认真想了想。

告诉他：“在意是互相的。”

你在乎我，我也会在意你。

余疏可能自己都不知道，他的存在对祝予来说并不只有‘看见’那么简单。

或许是曾经的经历导致，祝予对人际一直有着深深的防备。

她知道祝今也跟周复之爱她，所以她也会本能的回馈这份爱。

但其他人，哪怕对她再好，没有足够的事实依据，祝予不敢给予同等的感情。

像刘括，祝予以前没有把他看做家人，只能说是朋友，但在这个时间线里，刘括看着她长大，几乎把她当自己的孩子疼，他背上有道疤痕还是为了保护祝予才挨的一刀。

祝予因此将他看作家人。

而余疏……

祝予现在的一切都是因为他用命换来的，这种感情难道还需要考验吗？

但人心易变，以后的事谁也说不好，不过此时的祝予却是愿意信任余疏。

余疏在意她，她也会给予同样的感情。

听懂言下之意的余疏没有说话，他的沉默令祝予忍不住去看他的表情，但下一秒一只手便盖了上来，遮住了她的视线。

没等祝予发问，她便感受到了。

余疏在亲她。

不同于刚才的啄吻，带着浓烈激进的啃咬。

“……你也适合。”

“做抚慰犬。”

“余疏走了？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yu Shu asked: "Do you care about me?"

It seems that Yu Shu takes the initiative in the relationship between the two, but in fact Zhu Yu has always been in control.

Zhu Yu was good to him in the past, but not as good as now.

During his short stay at the Zhu family, the most common thing Yu Shu did was sit there and watch Zhu Yu talk to Zhou Fuzhi and Zhu Jinye.

As long as these two people are present, most of Zhu Yu's attention will be on them. That kind of concentration is something he couldn't understand when he didn't know the truth at the beginning.

After watching it for a long time, Yu Shu also developed greed in his heart.

He wanted this look too.

This kind of gaze will never be given up, let go, and gazed at for a long time.

He originally thought he would have to work hard for a long time until he reunited with Zhu Yu some time ago.

In the process of getting along, Yu Shu gradually discovered what he wanted, and Zhu Yu seemed to start to give it slowly.

Therefore, he also tried and boldly crossed that line.

Now it seems that Yu Shu feels that she seems to have his own figure in her eyes.

Although she couldn't compare with Zhu Jin or Zhou Fuzhi, she could still see it.

The eyes were magical. Even though Zhu Yu didn't know what Yu Shu was thinking, he could feel some of his emotions.

This time Zhu Yu did not act perfunctory like before, but thought about it seriously.

Tell him: "Care is mutual."

You care about me and I will care about you.

Yu Shu may not even know that his existence is not as simple as "seeing" to Zhu Yu.

Perhaps due to past experiences, Zhu Yu has always been deeply defensive about interpersonal relationships.

She knew that Zhu Jinye and Zhou Fuzhi loved her, so she would instinctively reciprocate this love.

But other people, no matter how nice they are to her, do not have enough factual basis, so Zhu Yu dare not give them the same affection.

Like Liu Kuo, Zhu Yu didn't regard him as a family member before, only a friend. But in this timeline, Liu Kuo watched her grow up and almost treated her as his own child. The scar on his back was because he was stabbed to protect Zhu Yu.

Zhu Yu therefore regards him as family.

And Yu Shu...

Everything Zhu Yu has now is because of his sacrifice of life. Does this kind of relationship still need to be tested?

But people's hearts are fickle, and no one can predict what will happen in the future, but at this time, Zhu Yu is willing to trust Yu Shu.

Yu Shu cares about her, and she will give him the same affection.

Yu Shu, who understood the implication, said nothing. His silence made Zhu Yu couldn't help but look at his expression, but the next second a hand came up, blocking her sight.

Before Zhu Yu could ask any questions, she felt it.

Yu Shu was kissing her.

It was different from the kiss just now, with strong and aggressive biting.

"...You are suitable too."

“Be a comfort dog.”

"Yu Shu is gone?"
